tono: con debate: ni celebrar ni condenar; contar qué cambió para los dos lados

arte.universo: Late 15th century, 1490s. The Caribbean islands (white sand, turquoise sea, palm trees, Taino villages with round thatched houses called bohíos and canoes carved from tree trunks), Mesoamerican markets full of maize, cacao beans, tomatoes, chiles and squash, and European elements of the time: three wooden caravels with square sails, rustic Spanish and Italian kitchens with stone ovens. Respectful toward the Indigenous peoples: no violence, no weapons, no conquerors in action.

escena.accion: In a dim rustic 15th-century Italian kitchen, the Pasita looks puzzled at a plain flatbread with only olive oil and herbs on a wooden table
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-middle part of the frame, three-quarter view from behind, small school backpack, curious puzzled pose
escena.objeto: A round plain flatbread with no tomato, on a wooden board, lit by a candle
escena.foreground: Clay jars, garlic and a knife on the table edge, slightly blurred
escena.midground: The Pasita and the table with the flatbread
escena.background: Stone oven with embers, hanging herbs, dark wooden beams
escena.iluminacion: Warm candle and ember light against cold darkness
escena.composicion: Medium shot, upper 42% dark (smoke and shadowed beams) for the title

cuerpo: Todo eso solo existía **de este lado del mar**.

escena.accion: The Pasita walks amazed through a lively Mesoamerican market, looking at baskets of produce
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-left, seen from behind, backpack on, head turned toward the baskets
escena.objeto: Woven baskets overflowing with maize cobs of many colors, cacao beans, red tomatoes, chiles and squash
escena.foreground: A basket of red chiles and tomatoes very close to the camera, slightly blurred
escena.midground: The Pasita among the market stalls
escena.background: Anonymous market vendors seen from behind under woven awnings, a pyramid temple silhouette far away in the haze
escena.iluminacion: Late afternoon light through dust, rich colors only on the food
escena.composicion: Wide shot, upper 42% hazy sky and awnings

cuerpo: Colón llegó a una isla del Caribe que los taínos llamaban **Guanahaní**.
Él creía que estaba en Asia.

escena.accion: At dawn, three wooden caravels with square sails appear on the horizon, seen from a quiet Caribbean beach
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-right, standing on the sand seen from behind, backpack on, watching the ships
escena.objeto: The three caravels on the horizon
escena.foreground: Palm leaves and a carved wooden canoe on the sand
escena.midground: The Pasita on the beach, footprints in the sand
escena.background: Turquoise sea, the three ships, a misty dawn sky
escena.iluminacion: Pale dawn light, cold blue with a thin line of warm sun
escena.emocion: Uncertainty, a historic moment about to happen
escena.composicion: Wide shot, the upper 42% is a calm dark-blue dawn sky

escena.accion: On the beach, a wooden rowboat from the ships and a Taino canoe rest facing each other, with objects laid between them on the sand
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-middle, seen from behind, standing between the two boats
escena.objeto: On the sand between the boats: a woven basket of maize and cacao on one side, a sack of wheat and a metal bell on the other
escena.midground: The two boats and the Pasita
escena.background: Taino round thatched houses on one side, the caravels at sea on the other
escena.composicion: Symmetrical wide shot, upper 42% calm sky

cuerpo: De allá llegaron **trigo, caballos y vacas**.

escena.accion: Inside the dark wooden hold of a caravel, the Pasita looks at the cargo: sacks of maize and cacao next to a horse and a cow
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-left, three-quarter view, backpack on, looking up at the horse
escena.objeto: Open sacks of maize cobs and cacao beans; a horse and a cow standing calmly
escena.foreground: Ropes and a wooden barrel, slightly blurred
escena.background: Wooden ribs of the ship, a lantern swinging
escena.iluminacion: A single warm lantern in the darkness, beams of light through the planks
escena.composicion: Medium-wide shot, upper 42% dark ship ceiling

cuerpo: Millones de personas de los pueblos originarios murieron: **no tenían defensas** contra esas enfermedades.

escena.accion: A silent Taino village at dusk, empty, with a single small fire and smoke rising; the Pasita sits alone on a log, head down
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-middle, sitting, seen from the side, sad and quiet
escena.objeto: Empty hammocks and an abandoned clay pot near the small fire
escena.foreground: Tall grass and a few flowers, slightly blurred
escena.midground: The Pasita on the log, the small fire
escena.background: Round thatched houses in silhouette, smoke rising into a dark sky
escena.iluminacion: Cold dusk light, a small warm fire
escena.composicion: Wide shot, upper 42% dark sky with smoke; nothing graphic, no people

cuerpo: Por eso hoy se discute **cómo recordarlo**.

escena.accion: The Pasita sits on a wooden desk at night looking at an old hand-drawn map of the Atlantic with two coasts, lit by a desk lamp
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-right, seen from behind and slightly from the side, backpack next to her
escena.objeto: An old parchment map with the two coasts and a dotted route across the ocean (no letters)
escena.foreground: Books and a magnifying glass, slightly blurred
escena.background: Shelves with old books and a small globe in the dark
escena.iluminacion: Warm desk lamp against a dark room
escena.composicion: Medium shot, upper 42% dark room for the title

post:
12 de octubre de 1492: el día en que dos mundos que no se conocían se encontraron. 🌎

Antes de esa fecha, en Europa no había jitomate, papa, chocolate ni chile. Y a América llegaron el trigo, los caballos… y la viruela, que causó la muerte de millones de personas de los pueblos originarios.

No fue solo un descubrimiento: fue un encuentro y un choque. ¿Qué no comerías hoy sin esa fecha? 👇

#12deoctubre #historia #historiademexico #secundaria #pasasmx
